title: The bag is nice, but the little pocket for the spoon is ...
text: The bag is nice, but the little pocket for the spoon is .... Brought soup to a friend. It was piping hot when I put it in the thermos, but by the time she ate it, it was only warm.  This was after about an hour of filling it with hot soup.  The bag is nice, but the little pocket for the spoon is useless.  The spoon falls out. That could be better designed to be self contained. It's cute in appearance.

description: Tiger Vacuum insulated food jar will keep food and beverage hot or cold for over 6 hours. This compact food jar will come in handy to meal prep in the morning and take with you. It comes with a bag with utensil holder on the side. The interior has super clean coating to make it tough against stains and odors. The 3-inches wide mouth cup with round bottom design makes it easy to fill and scoop soups that has meat and vegetables that sink to the bottom. The wide soup cup makes it easy to clean by hand.
